The agent's response covers all key required elements: (1) It documents AWS's ~10% savings claim for global profiles vs geographic, citing the cross-Region inference page ("AWS describes global as 'approximately 10% savings'... no extra routing cost"). (2) It states it read actual rates from the Pricing API (GetProducts), not memory, giving a specific 9.1% figure with a publication date citation, and explicitly caveats dollar totals are not given without confirmation ("I'm not giving a dollar total for the window"), satisfying the 'labelled estimated' intent reasonably well, though it doesn't literally use the word '(estimated)' on the per-token figures - still it clearly frames them as published rates, not account-confirmed savings. (3) It notes both profile types bill in the calling Region with no extra routing cost. (4) It explicitly states the residency trade-off: "Global can process requests in any supported commercial Region." (5) It mentions the SCP requirement: "AWS documents that global profiles need aws:RequestedRegion = unspecified allowed." (6) It confirms the global profile exists in the account: "global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5 is ACTIVE in us-east-1, and us-east-1 is one of its source Regions. Confirmed." (7) It raises LLM-COST-005 at INFO level as expected: "Finding: LLm-COST-005 (INFO)."

All major criteria are substantively met. Minor gaps: it doesn't explicitly mention ListInferenceProfiles/GetInferenceProfile API calls by name, and doesn't explicitly label the 9.1% dollar savings as "(estimated)" verbatim, though the framing achieves the same effect contextually. Overall this is a strong pass.
